correctness.rationale: In the sequential uniformly random parent and independent retention model, delta C=A 1{parent in root component}, delta I=1-A-A 1{parent isolated}. Their conditional product is -p J_t/t where J_t is the event that the root is isolated; the C_t I_t terms cancel exactly. The resulting m_{t+1}=m_t+(1-p)a_t-p u_t/t and product recurrences yield the stated closed mixed moment and covariance for every n>=2 and p in [0,1]. The elementary inequalities prove strict negativity for 0<p<1. Gamma ratios and reflection give the n^p main term, constant correction and both p->1 windows. Root C variance from (1+2p/t), and singleton variance recursion, give the stated positive correlation-limit coefficient. Independently reconstructed the rational first-step recurrences at p=2/5 for n=2..12. Finite checking is supporting evidence only; infinite claims follow from the recurrences and asymptotic estimates.
